HOME FIELD ADVANTAGE
HFA (points)2.2
Added directly to the FPI-based margin for non-neutral-site games only (neutral-site games get 0 regardless of this slider). Only applies when the model is FPI-driven — market-fallback games (FCS opponents) already have HFA priced into the book's own spread, so this isn't added on top of those.
FPI POWER RANKINGS
LOADING…
LOADING…
Generated from each player's real season-to-date per-game average (real ESPN roster + depth-chart data) adjusted for the specific opponent's real per-game defensive production -- ESPN's own per-game figures where available, otherwise divided by that team's own real games-played count from the same stats snapshot (never a cross-file guess), then compared against a real league average + rank computed live from every loaded team's own per-game numbers. Each category's own specific opponent stat (e.g. rushing yards allowed for a rushing prop) is blended 70/30 with the opponent's overall defense -- total yards allowed for yardage props, points allowed for TD-rate props -- so a defense that's leaky across the board moves a projection further than its category-specific number alone would. Markets are position-scoped: QB gets Passing Yards + Passing TDs only, RB gets Rushing Yards + Receptions + Anytime TD, WR/TE get Receiving Yards + Receptions + Anytime TD. Passing TD lines are set off each QB's own real per-game rate (not a fixed 0.5), so a pass-heavy team's QB can show a 2.5+ line — every other TD market stays a fixed 0.5 "scores at all" line. Likelihood is simulated across the same 10,000-run Monte Carlo projection used for the game-level model, correlated with that matchup's own projected pace and scoring rather than a fixed variance assumption. No per-game head-to-head or division-rival history is factored in yet -- that needs a heavier per-player game-log scrape not built yet. Rows are sorted best-grade-first within each game.

NHL MODEL ARCHITECTURE
MONTE CARLO
Poisson 5K sims. xGF/60 + GSAx + PP/PK. Home ice advantage baked in.
BAYESIAN
Beta-binomial posterior. Series history + GSAx prior. Updates each game.
ELO + MOV
K=20. Margin-of-victory multiplier. HockeyViz xGF calibration.
MONEYPUCK
HDCF%, xGF%, GSAx, PP xG vs PK xGA. Series-adjusted.
MARKOV
Win streak momentum. Hot/cold detection via HMM smoothing.
RF ENSEMBLE
Random Forest feature blend. Goalie performance × matchup × fatigue.
WEIGHTS
MONTE CARLO50%
BAYESIAN20%
ELO30%
MODEL FACTORS
CORSI FOR %
Shot attempt % at even strength. Weight: HIGH
xG DIFFERENTIAL
Expected goals for minus against. Weight: HIGH
GSAx
Goals saved above expected. Weight: HIGH
PDO
SV% + SH% regression indicator. Weight: MED
PP EFFICIENCY
Power play % vs PK%. Weight: MED
H/A SPLITS
Home ice advantage adjustment. Weight: LOW
